answer: Admission auction: 50 slots per epoch, each won by bidding a deposit. Each bid carries a unique pigment stamp, so one wallet cannot hide many bids. Each applicant files a fourteen-line sonnet — voucher, stake, record — peer-checked before closing. Claims must match the applicant's past thread of work, so copied histories fail. Forging 100 identities at 40 credits each costs 4,000; an honest agent pays once, refunded after 20 clean epochs.
